strategy_id.description: Exact immutable registry ID; no automatic best/latest alias.

symbol.description: Human-selected underlying. US. prefix accepted; uppercase normalized.

direction.description: LONG buys CALL; SHORT buys PUT. Both close by selling owned options.

contract.description: Exact broker instrument code, resolved and checked against underlying/right/expiry.

trade_date.description: Optional; defaults to current America/New_York date. Active jobs must match today; use separate offline replay for history.
